description: Two stacked photographs from U.S. Senator John McCain's May 2013 trip to Syria, where he posed with Syrian opposition/rebel figures outside a building with web-patterned door grilles. In both frames McCain, in a dark polo shirt, stands among armed and unarmed men; the bottom photo also includes a man in a striped shirt consistent with Free Syrian Army chief of staff Gen. Salim Idriss and a woman in a pink blazer and headscarf. One young man wearing a gray graphic t-shirt appears in both photos, and another man carries a rifle. These images circulated widely with disputed claims that some of the men were later ISIS members or kidnappers.
flags: Man in striped shirt consistent with Gen. Salim Idriss but not confirmed by any text in the image
Widely circulated claims that men in these photos were ISIS members/kidnappers are disputed and not supported by the image itself; those men are left unnamed
T-shirt slogan partially obscured; transcribed as best legible

description: Press photograph of Syrian President Bashar al-Assad, in a dark suit, shaking hands with Saudi Prince Alwaleed bin Talal, who wears a red-and-white checked keffiyeh and beige robes. Behind them is a black commemorative plaque with gilded Arabic inscription and decorative yellow flowers. The scene is consistent with the 2006 opening of the Four Seasons Hotel in Damascus, an Alwaleed-backed project. AFP/Getty Images credit watermark in the lower left.

description: Photograph of U.S. President George W. Bush, in a white shirt, khakis and cowboy boots, gesturing while seated in a floral-upholstered armchair opposite Saudi Ambassador Prince Bandar bin Sultan, who wears a navy blazer and jeans. They sit in a book-lined room with a dining table, striped chairs and a library ladder. The scene is consistent with widely published photos of their August 2002 meeting at Bush's ranch in Crawford, Texas.
